# England Genealogy



[Europe](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Europe "Europe")

England

Guide to **England ancestry, family history and genealogy**: parish registers, transcripts, census records, birth records, marriage records, and death records.

## Information

**England** is one of the four constituent countries of the [United Kingdom](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/United_Kingdom "United Kingdom") (together with [Scotland](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Scotland_Genealogy "Scotland Genealogy"), [Wales](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Wales_Genealogy "Wales Genealogy") and [Northern Ireland](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Northern_Ireland_Genealogy "Northern Ireland Genealogy")). It has a history that goes back over a thousand years. In 1707, the Kingdom of England joined the [Kingdom of Scotland](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Scotland_Genealogy "Scotland Genealogy") in union to become the [Kingdom of Great Britain](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Great_Britain "Great Britain"). The official language is English.[[1]](#cite_note-1)

## England Map

Genealogy records are kept at the Parish level in England. The map below shows county boundaries as of 1851. Click on a county below to go to the county Wiki article listing more information.

![England 1851 antique style with Isle of Man.png](/en/wiki/img_auth.php/thumb/5/54/England_1851_antique_style_with_Isle_of_Man.png/550px-England_1851_antique_style_with_Isle_of_Man.png)

## Counties and Parishes
